prompt: After rotating and drawing, all subsequent shapes are also rotated unexpectedly. Why?
choices: rotate() permanently changes the canvas orientation
The transform was not saved and restored — rotate() modifies the Graphics2D state permanently for this paint cycle
rotate() applies to shapes, not the coordinate system
explanation: Graphics2D transforms accumulate. To rotate only one shape: AffineTransform saved = g2d.getTransform(); g2d.rotate(angle); g2d.fillRect(...); g2d.setTransform(saved); Or use: g2d.rotate(angle, cx, cy) to rotate around a specific center point.
